resources.summary: Publisher chapter titles and page ranges with CRARA study notes in English and Chichewa. Licensed chapter text is not bundled.

book.title: Regression Methods in Biostatistics
book.subtitle: Linear, Logistic, Survival, and Repeated Measures Models
book.accessNoteEn: Licensed text. CRARA supplies the publisher's chapter outline only; open the Springer link for the full chapter (preview or subscription may be required).
book.accessNoteNy: Buku lili ndi chilolezo. CRARA imapereka mndandanda wa mitu yokha; tsegulani ulalo wa Springer kuti muwerenge chaputala chonse.

chapters.title: Introduction
chapters.scopeEn: Frames the book's unified approach to multipredictor regression and the common workflow used throughout.
chapters.scopeNy: Chiyambi: chimafotokoza njira imodzi yogwirizana yophunzirira ma regression okhala ndi zolosera zambiri.

chapters.title: Exploratory and Descriptive Methods
chapters.scopeEn: Describes and explores biomedical data before modelling, preparing the outcome and predictor summaries used later.
chapters.scopeNy: Kufufuza ndi kufotokoza deta musanamange chitsanzo; kumakonza zidziwitso za zotsatira ndi zolosera.

chapters.title: Basic Statistical Methods
chapters.scopeEn: Reviews first-course statistical methods before the multipredictor models are introduced.
chapters.scopeNy: Kubwereza njira zoyambirira za ziwerengero zisanaphunziridwe ma model okhala ndi zolosera zambiri.

chapters.title: Linear Regression
chapters.scopeEn: Multiple linear regression for continuous outcomes, using the shared framework for selection, estimation, checking and interpretation.
chapters.scopeNy: Linear regression ya zotsatira zoyezeka mosalekeza, pogwiritsa ntchito njira yofanana yosankha, kuyerekeza, kuyang'ana ndi kutanthauzira.

chapters.title: Logistic Regression
chapters.scopeEn: Logistic models for binary outcomes, applying the same model-choice, checking and interpretation framework.
chapters.scopeNy: Logistic regression ya zotsatira za awiri (inde/ayi), pogwiritsa ntchito njira yomweyo yosankha ndi kutanthauzira.

chapters.title: Survival Analysis
chapters.scopeEn: The Cox model and related methods for right-censored survival times.
chapters.scopeNy: Cox model ndi njira zina za nthawi yopulumuka pamene deta ina sinamalizidwe (right-censored).

chapters.title: Repeated Measures and Longitudinal Data Analysis
chapters.scopeEn: Models for longitudinal and hierarchical outcomes where observations are correlated, including repeated-measures approaches.
chapters.scopeNy: Ma model a deta yobwerezedwa kapena yotsatira nthawi, pamene mfundo zaza deta zimagwirizana.

chapters.title: Generalized Linear Models
chapters.scopeEn: Generalized linear models extending the regression framework to counts and other non-normal outcome types.
chapters.scopeNy: Generalized linear models zowonjezera njira ya regression ku zotsatira zowerengeka ndi zina zosagwirizana ndi normal.

chapters.title: Strengthening Causal Inference
chapters.scopeEn: How the regression methods handle confounding, mediation and interaction of causal effects in essentially the same way.
chapters.scopeNy: Kulimbikitsa kutanthauzira kwa chifukwa: confounding, mediation ndi interaction zimayendetsedwa mofanana.

chapters.title: Predictor Selection
chapters.scopeEn: Strategies for choosing predictors and checking the resulting multipredictor models.
chapters.scopeNy: Njira zosankha zolosera zabwino ndikuyang'ana chitsanzo chomwe chatsatira.

chapters.title: Missing Data
chapters.scopeEn: Approaches to missingness within the regression workflow, with applied guidance.
chapters.scopeNy: Njira zothanirana ndi deta yosowa mu ntchito ya regression, ndi malangizo ogwiritsira ntchito.

chapters.title: Complex Surveys
chapters.scopeEn: A brief introduction to regression analysis of complex survey data.
chapters.scopeNy: Chiyambi chachifupi cha regression pa deta ya kafukufuku wovuta (complex surveys).

chapters.title: Summary
chapters.scopeEn: Consolidates the elements shared across all the model families in the book.
chapters.scopeNy: Kufotokoza mwachidule zinthu zofanana pakati pa ma model onse omwe ali m'bukuli.
